scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: Headings must always use Anton, uppercase, with tight tracking.
Never use Inter for H1, H2, or H3.
Body text must use Inter with readable line height.
Primary dark background (#0E0E10) is the default.
Use Off-white (#F5F4F0) for specific light sections (like About or Testimonials) to create strong contrast breaks.
Electric Lime (#D4FF3F) for primary CTAs and active states.
Coral-red (#FF4E4E) for secondary CTAs, warnings, or highlights.
No generic gradients. Use flat colors or subtle noise textures.

textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on dark sections to kill digital flatness.
Diagonal section breaks using CSS clip-path or SVG shapes.
surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky nav and floating cards: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10.
Solid off-white cards on light sections with sharp 2px black borders and brutalist hard shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #0E0E10).

rules: Use asymmetric bento layouts for program tiles and feature highlights.
Never fill 100% perfectly symmetrically; leave negative space.
Use span logic: col-span-full md:col-span-8 for heroes, col-span-4 for supporting cards.

spacing: Generous spacing: py-20 md:py-32 for sections.
Internal padding for bordered cards: p-6 or p-8.
patterns: Hero: Full-bleed image/video with heavy typography overlay. Dark overlay max bg-black/50.
Sticky Nav: Persistent 'Book Free Trial' CTA in Lime. Glassmorphic background.
Diagonal breaks: Transform skewY(-2deg) on section containers for dynamic athletic feel.
Dashboards: Sidebar navigation, clean grid, soft white backgrounds for readability.

interactions: Magnetic hover effect on primary buttons.
Scroll-parallax on hero and diagonal section background images.
Animated stat counters (0 to X) on scroll into view.
Staggered entrance for bento grid cards.
rules: Do not use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transform/opacity transitions.

components.name: Navigation
components.rules: Sticky top, glassmorphism, visible links on desktop, lime CTA button. NEVER fully transparent.

components.name: HeroSection
components.rules: Full height or min-h-[80vh], parallax background, dark overlay (bg-black/50), oversized Anton typography.

components.name: ProgramTiles
components.rules: Bento grid, hover zoom on images, diagonal accent lines.

components.name: TestimonialCarousel
components.rules: Use framer-motion or a simple flex overflow-x-auto snap-x for mobile, grid for desktop.

components.name: InteractiveCalendar
components.rules: Filterable by age/program. Color-coded (Lime = Open, Red = Full, White = Event).

components.name: PricingCards
components.rules: Two-tier (Tot Party vs Birthday Party). Highlight tier with lime border/shadow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or gradient underlays). Lime text on white must be checked, use dark text on lime backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

3d_libraries.usage: Minimal. Focus on high-quality 2D imagery and Framer Motion for parallax and bento animations.

hero.description: Girl jumping on trampoline, high energy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page marketing site + dashboard.
Implement routing for Home, About, Preschool, Rec Classes, Competitive, Cheer, Camps, Events, Calendar, Parties, Recruits, Contact, and Dashboards (Parent/Admin).
Use Shadcn UI extensively for forms, tables, dialogs, and dashboards, but heavily customize the look to match the Athletic/Performance Pro archetype (sharp corners, minimal radius, high contrast).
For marketing pages, rely on raw Tailwind + HTML to build asymmetric bento layouts and diagonal sections.
Ensure the sticky navbar is always readable with a glassmorphic dark background, never fully transparent.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Include an interactive calendar and complex booking/pricing components as requested.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI outputs. Be creative with layout and typography.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark colors.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Never use 'transition: all'. Apply transitions to specific properties like transform and opacity.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8, p-12, py-24).
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp-edged buttons with interaction animations.
Add micro-animations for hover states and page load.
